title: Bicycle Shop in China - Incolor Bike Review (A Chinese SuperBike?)

takeaways.text: The shop's Speedster with a semi-wireless QED groupset, carbon cranks and in-house wheels and cockpit weighed 6.3 kg; frame size was not stated.
In November 2025 the shop priced the frameset at CNY 18,800 (the SR+ list price) and this complete build at CNY 28,800.

disclosure: Filmed at Tianjin shop Rubike, which provides bikes for the channel's reviews; the channel is sponsored by an apparel brand. The ride section uses the shop owner's SSR, not this Speedster.
summary: Shop look at a built Incolor Speedster with prices and a weigh-in; the ride impressions that follow are on the shop owner's SSR.
